name: KARMEN
full_name: KArlsruhe Rutherford Medium Energy Neutrino experiment
summary: KARMEN used the pulsed ISIS stopped-pion source to search for electron-antineutrino appearance and measure low-energy neutrino interactions, providing a complementary test of the LSND region.
physics_targets: Neutrino-nucleus reactions at tens of MeV
Tests of the LSND oscillation interpretation
detection_principle: A segmented liquid-scintillator detector recorded prompt positrons and delayed neutron-capture signals from inverse beta decay. The narrow ISIS pulses, active veto system and heavy shielding strongly constrained cosmic and beam-related backgrounds.

results.summary: Selected 15 appearance candidates against an expectation of 15.8 +/- 0.5 background events, finding no indication of the searched oscillation signal.
